 Increases the character's Crit Rate by 75%.

boundaries.description: Increases the character's Crit DMG by an amount equal to 20% of their Ultimate Charte Rate, up to 40%.

corePassives.description:
After entering Mod Enhancement, Urahara applies 1 stack of Mod Scars to enemies every 4.5 seconds: Each stack reduces Slash Resistance by 3%, up to 3 stacks for 12 seconds. Additionally, when Urahara's Special Attack hits an enemy, it applies 1 stack of Scar Exposure for each stack of Mod Scars on the target: Increases damage taken by 1% per stack, up to 3 stacks for 25 seconds. 
 When the team includes three different types, the entire team gains 80% Crit DMG Bonus. The effects provided by Urahara's own Core Passive and Passive Boost are also multiplied by 2.
corePassives.name: Mod

corePassives.description: During battle, increases Ultimate Charge Rate by 22.5%.
corePassives.name: Revelation

corePassives.description:
At the start of battle, if Urahara's ATK exceeds 3200, the entire team gains 3.75% Slash DMG Bonus. 
 For every additional 480 ATK above this threshold, the entire team gains an extra 1.5% Slash DMG Bonus, up to a maximum extra bonus of 7.5%.
corePassives.name: Construction

corePassives.description: While Mod Enhancement  is active, increases all Slash characters' ATK by 7.5%.
corePassives.name: Tactics

rotations.name: 140? Ult charge

skills.description:
Urahara swings Benihime in a series of 5 slashes, dealing total damage equal to 84% of ATK ~~Self-Mod~~ With 3 Mod Marks, tap and hold Basic Attack or switch in from the backline 
 Urahara modifies his hands, then grips his Zanpakuto with both hands to deliver a powerful slash, consuming 3 Mod Marks and dealing damage equal to 97% of ATK.
skills.name: Bankai - Kannon-Biraki Benihime Aratame

skills.description:
Urahara rapidly delivers two powerful slashes imbued with mod power, dealing damage equal to 80% of ATK. ~~Environmental Reconstruction~~ Usable once during the Mod Enhancement state 
 Urahara rushes toward the enemy, modifying the terrain to partially gather enemies in his path, then strikes with a powerful slash. Deals total damage equal to 141% of ATK, applies 3 stacks of Mod Scars to the target, and gains 3 Mod Marks.
skills.name: Enemy Mod

skills.description:
After being reconstructed by the manifested Benihime, Urahara leaps at the enemy and unleashes a powerful slash, dealing total damage equal to 170% of ATK and entering Mod Enhancement for 21 seconds. 
 While in this state, he periodically applies 1 stack of Mod Scars to all enemies and gain 1 Mod Mark. ~~Already Too Late~~ Mod Enhancement State 
 Urahara moves swiftly along suture lines created by reconstructing space, unleashing several immensely powerful slashes that deal total damage equal to 211% of ATK and ending his Mod Enhancement state.
skills.name: Already Modified

skills.description: After parrying an enemy attack, Urahara quickly dashes toward the enemy and delivers a slash, dealing total damage equal to 320% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Urahara gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step

ascend1: Passive Boost - Strategy gains an extra effect: During Mod Enhancement, all allied Slash characters gain 15% Crit DMG Bonus.
Core Passive - Mod gains an extra effect: Applying Scar Exposure grants the entire team 1 stack of Ultimate Enhancement, increasing Ultimate Mastery by 2.5% for 25 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times.

During Mod Enhancement, each Mod Mark consumed grants the character 1 stack of Mod Charge, increasing the damage of his next Enhanced Ultimate - Already Too Late by 3.5% per stack. Stacks up to 6 times.
When the Enhanced Ultimate - Already Too Late hits an enemy, it deals an additional instance of damage equal to 4% of the total Slash DMG the enemy takes from the character during Mod Enhancement.
When the Ultimate - Already Modified hits, applies Mod Dismantling to the target, reducing their Slash Resistance by 7.5% for 25 seconds.

Increases the maximum stacks of Scar Exposure applied by the character to 8. When his Special attacks hit a target, it now applies 2 stacks of Scar Exposure for each stack of Mod Scars on that target.
ascend5: When the Ultimate - Already Modified hits, applies Mod Dismantling to the target, reducing their Slash Resistance by 15% for 25 seconds.

Increases the maximum stacks of Scar Exposure applied by the character to 12. When his Special attacks hit a target, it now applies 2 stacks of Scar Exposure for each stack of Mod Scars on that target.
